      { data: [{ access_token: 'synthetic-short-token', user_id: 'synthetic-authref', permissions: 'instagram_business_basic' }] },
      { data: [{ access_token: 'synthetic-short-token', user_id: 'synthetic-authref', permissions: 'instagram_business_basic,instagram_business_manage_messages' }, { access_token: 'second', user_id: 'second', permissions: 'instagram_business_basic,instagram_business_manage_messages' }] },
      { data: [{ access_token: 'synthetic-short-token', user_id: 'synthetic-authref', permissions: 'instagram_business_basic,instagram_business_manage_messages' }] },
    ];
    for (let index = 0; index < malformed.length; index += 1) {
      instagramFake.shortEnvelope = malformed[index];
      if (index === 2) instagramFake.meEnvelope = { user_id: 1020304050, username: 'numeric_id_must_fail' };
      const created = await request(app.getHttpServer()).post(`/api/bff/business-units/${buId}/instagram-authorizations`)
        .set('cookie', cookie).set('x-requested-with', 'teste').set('idempotency-key', randomUUID())
        .send({ operation: 'REAUTHORIZE', channelId: channel.id, expectedGeneration: channel.generation }).expect(201);
      const state = new URL(created.body.authorizationUrl).searchParams.get('state')!;
      await request(app.getHttpServer()).get('/api/bff/instagram-authorizations/callback').set('cookie', cookie)
        .query({ state, code: `synthetic-invalid-token-fixture-${index}` }).expect(303);
      const failed = await prisma.instagramAuthorizationAttempt.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: created.body.id } });
      expect(failed.status).toBe('FAILED_SAFE');
      expect(JSON.stringify(failed)).not.toContain('synthetic-invalid-token-fixture');
      instagramFake.shortEnvelope = null;
      instagramFake.meEnvelope = null;
    }
    const current = await prisma.channelCredential.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { channelId: channel.id } });
    expect(Buffer.from(current.ciphertext).toString('hex')).toBe(priorCiphertext);
    instagramFake.longEnvelope = { access_token: 'synthetic-invalid-expiry-token', expires_in: Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER + 1 };
    const invalidExpiry = await request(app.getHttpServer()).post(`/api/bff/business-units/${buId}/instagram-authorizations`)
      .set('cookie', cookie).set('x-requested-with', 'teste').set('idempotency-key', randomUUID())
      .send({ operation: 'REAUTHORIZE', channelId: channel.id, expectedGeneration: channel.generation }).expect(201);
    await request(app.getHttpServer()).get('/api/bff/instagram-authorizations/callback').set('cookie', cookie)
      .query({ state: new URL(invalidExpiry.body.authorizationUrl).searchParams.get('state'), code: 'synthetic-invalid-expiry-code' }).expect(303);
    instagramFake.longEnvelope = null;
    expect(Buffer.from((await prisma.channelCredential.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { channelId: channel.id } })).ciphertext).toString('hex')).toBe(priorCiphertext);
  });

  it('CP2-CALLBACK: revalidates session, grant, attempt and lease after each provider await and anchors expiry to token receipt', async () => {
    const reserve = async (key = randomUUID()) => request(app.getHttpServer()).post(`/api/bff/business-units/${buId}/instagram-authorizations`)
      .set('cookie', alternateAdminCookie).set('x-requested-with', 'teste').set('idempotency-key', key).send({ operation: 'CONNECT' }).expect(201);

    const cancelledReservation = await reserve();
    const cancelledId = cancelledReservation.body.id as string;
    const cancelledState = new URL(cancelledReservation.body.authorizationUrl).searchParams.get('state')!;
    let releaseRequest!: () => void;
    let enteredRequest!: () => void;
    const waiting = new Promise<void>((resolve) => { enteredRequest = resolve; });
    const held = new Promise<void>((resolve) => { releaseRequest = resolve; });
    instagramFake.afterRequestHook = async (_method, url) => { if (url.pathname === '/oauth/access_token') { enteredRequest(); await held; } };
    const callsBeforeCancel = instagramFake.calls.length;
    const pendingCallback = request(app.getHttpServer()).get('/api/bff/instagram-authorizations/callback').set('cookie', alternateAdminCookie)
      .query({ state: cancelledState, code: 'synthetic-delayed-cancel-code' }).then((response) => response);
    let cancelled: { body: { status: string } } | undefined;
    try {
      await awaitBarrierBeforeRequest(waiting, pendingCallback, 'cancelled callback provider request');
      cancelled = await request(app.getHttpServer()).post(`/api/bff/instagram-authorizations/${cancelledId}/cancel`)
        .set('cookie', alternateAdminCookie).set('x-requested-with', 'teste').send({}).expect(200);
    } finally {
      releaseRequest();
      instagramFake.afterRequestHook = null;
      await Promise.allSettled([pendingCallback]);
    }
    expect(cancelled?.body.status).toBe('CANCELLED');
    expect((await pendingCallback).status).toBe(303);
    expect(instagramFake.calls.length - callsBeforeCancel).toBe(1);

    const leaseReservation = await reserve();
    const leaseId = leaseReservation.body.id as string;
    const leaseState = new URL(leaseReservation.body.authorizationUrl).searchParams.get('state')!;
    instagramFake.afterRequestHook = async (_method, url) => {
      if (url.pathname === '/oauth/access_token') await prisma.instagramAuthorizationAttempt.update({
        where: { id: leaseId }, data: { callbackLeaseToken: 'synthetic-lease-takeover', callbackLeaseUntil: new Date(Date.now() + 60_000) },
      });
    };
    const callsBeforeTakeover = instagramFake.calls.length;
    const takeover = await request(app.getHttpServer()).get('/api/bff/instagram-authorizations/callback').set('cookie', alternateAdminCookie)
      .query({ state: leaseState, code: 'synthetic-taken-over-lease-code' });
    expect(takeover.status).toBe(303);
    expect(takeover.headers['cache-control']).toContain('no-store');
    expect(takeover.headers['referrer-policy']).toBe('no-referrer');
    const returnUrl = new URL(takeover.headers.location, process.env.WEB_ORIGIN?.trim() || 'http://localhost');
    expect(returnUrl.origin).toBe(process.env.WEB_ORIGIN?.trim() || 'http://localhost');
    expect(returnUrl.pathname).toBe('/numeros');
    expect([...returnUrl.searchParams.keys()]).toEqual(['instagramAuthorizationError']);
    expect(returnUrl.searchParams.get('instagramAuthorizationError')).toBe('OAUTH_ATTEMPT_STALE');
    expect(takeover.headers.location).not.toMatch(/synthetic-taken-over-lease-code|state=|provider/);
    expect(instagramFake.calls.length - callsBeforeTakeover).toBe(1);
    instagramFake.afterRequestHook = null;
    await prisma.instagramAuthorizationAttempt.update({ where: { id: leaseId }, data: { callbackLeaseToken: null, callbackLeaseUntil: null } });
    await request(app.getHttpServer()).post(`/api/bff/instagram-authorizations/${leaseId}/cancel`)
      .set('cookie', alternateAdminCookie).set('x-requested-with', 'teste').send({}).expect(200);

    const revokedReservation = await reserve();
    const revokedId = revokedReservation.body.id as string;
    const revokedState = new URL(revokedReservation.body.authorizationUrl).searchParams.get('state')!;
    const grant = await prisma.userBuRole.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { userId_buId: { userId: alternateAdminId, buId } } });
    let releaseRevoked!: () => void;
    let enteredRevoked!: () => void;
    const waitingRevoked = new Promise<void>((resolve) => { enteredRevoked = resolve; });
    const heldRevoked = new Promise<void>((resolve) => { releaseRevoked = resolve; });
    instagramFake.afterRequestHook = async (_method, url) => { if (url.pathname === '/oauth/access_token') { enteredRevoked(); await heldRevoked; } };
    const callsBeforeRevocation = instagramFake.calls.length;
    const revokedCallback = request(app.getHttpServer()).get('/api/bff/instagram-authorizations/callback').set('cookie', alternateAdminCookie)
      .query({ state: revokedState, code: 'synthetic-revoked-grant-code' }).then((response) => response);
    let grantDeleted = false;
    try {
      await awaitBarrierBeforeRequest(waitingRevoked, revokedCallback, 'revoked-grant callback provider request');
      await prisma.userBuRole.delete({ where: { id: grant.id } });
      grantDeleted = true;
    } finally {
      releaseRevoked();
      instagramFake.afterRequestHook = null;
      await Promise.allSettled([revokedCallback]);
      if (grantDeleted) await prisma.userBuRole.create({ data: {
        userId: grant.userId, buId: grant.buId, role: grant.role,
        grantedViaTipo: grant.grantedViaTipo, grantedViaId: grant.grantedViaId,
      } });
    }
    expect((await revokedCallback).status).toBe(303);
    expect(instagramFake.calls.length - callsBeforeRevocation).toBe(1);
    const revokedAttempt = await prisma.instagramAuthorizationAttempt.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: revokedId } });
    expect(revokedAttempt.candidateKeyId).toBeNull();
    expect(revokedAttempt.candidateCiphertext).toBeNull();
    expect(await prisma.channelCredential.count({ where: { buId, provider: 'INSTAGRAM' } })).toBe(1);
    await request(app.getHttpServer()).post(`/api/bff/instagram-authorizations/${revokedId}/cancel`)
      .set('cookie', alternateAdminCookie).set('x-requested-with', 'teste').send({}).expect(200);

    const passwordReservation = await reserve();
    const passwordId = passwordReservation.body.id as string;
    const passwordState = new URL(passwordReservation.body.authorizationUrl).searchParams.get('state')!;
    const userBeforePasswordChange = await prisma.appUser.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: alternateAdminId }, select: { passwordChangedAt: true } });
    let releasePassword!: () => void;
    let enterPassword!: () => void;
    const waitingPassword = new Promise<void>((resolve) => { enterPassword = resolve; });
    const heldPassword = new Promise<void>((resolve) => { releasePassword = resolve; });
    instagramFake.afterRequestHook = async (_method, url) => { if (url.pathname === '/oauth/access_token') { enterPassword(); await heldPassword; } };
    const callsBeforePasswordChange = instagramFake.calls.length;
    const passwordCallback = request(app.getHttpServer()).get('/api/bff/instagram-authorizations/callback').set('cookie', alternateAdminCookie)
      .query({ state: passwordState, code: 'synthetic-password-revoked-callback-code' }).then((response) => response);
    try {
      await awaitBarrierBeforeRequest(waitingPassword, passwordCallback, 'password-change callback provider request');
      await prisma.appUser.update({ where: { id: alternateAdminId }, data: { passwordChangedAt: new Date(Date.now() + 1_000) } });
      releasePassword();
      expect((await passwordCallback).status).toBe(303);
      expect(instagramFake.calls.length - callsBeforePasswordChange).toBe(1);
      const passwordAttempt = await prisma.instagramAuthorizationAttempt.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: passwordId } });
      expect(passwordAttempt.candidateKeyId).toBeNull();
      expect(passwordAttempt.candidateCiphertext).toBeNull();
      expect(await prisma.channelCredential.count({ where: { buId, provider: 'INSTAGRAM' } })).toBe(1);
    } finally {
      releasePassword();
      instagramFake.afterRequestHook = null;
      await prisma.appUser.update({ where: { id: alternateAdminId }, data: { passwordChangedAt: userBeforePasswordChange.passwordChangedAt } });
      await Promise.allSettled([passwordCallback]);
    }

    const expiryReservation = await reserve();
    const expiryId = expiryReservation.body.id as string;
    const expiryState = new URL(expiryReservation.body.authorizationUrl).searchParams.get('state')!;
    instagramFake.longEnvelope = { access_token: 'synthetic-short-lived-fixture', expires_in: 90 };
    instagramFake.afterRequestHook = async (_method, url) => {
      if (url.pathname === '/v26.0/me') await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 2500));
    };
    const expiryCallback = await request(app.getHttpServer()).get('/api/bff/instagram-authorizations/callback').set('cookie', alternateAdminCookie)
      .query({ state: expiryState, code: 'synthetic-expiry-anchor-code' }).expect(303);
    const expiryAttempt = await prisma.instagramAuthorizationAttempt.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: expiryId } });
    expect(expiryCallback.headers.location).not.toContain('synthetic-expiry-anchor-code');
    expect(expiryAttempt.credentialExpiresAt!.getTime() - instagramFake.longTokenIssuedAt!).toBeLessThanOrEqual(91_000);
    await request(app.getHttpServer()).post(`/api/bff/instagram-authorizations/${expiryId}/cancel`)
      .set('cookie', alternateAdminCookie).set('x-requested-with', 'teste').send({}).expect(200);
    instagramFake.longEnvelope = null;
    instagramFake.afterRequestHook = null;
  });

  it('CP2-CONFIRM: refuses cross-BU ownership claims for an already mapped professional resource', async () => {
    const original = await prisma.buChannel.findFirstOrThrow({ where: { buId, businessIdentity: { externalResourceId: professionalId } }, include: { credential: true } });
    const originalCiphertext = Buffer.from(original.credential!.ciphertext).toString('hex');
    const authorization = await request(app.getHttpServer()).post(`/api/bff/business-units/${otherBuId}/instagram-authorizations`)
      .set('cookie', otherBuCookie).set('x-requested-with', 'teste').set('idempotency-key', randomUUID()).send({ operation: 'CONNECT' }).expect(201);
    await request(app.getHttpServer()).get('/api/bff/instagram-authorizations/callback').set('cookie', otherBuCookie)
      .query({ state: new URL(authorization.body.authorizationUrl).searchParams.get('state'), code: 'synthetic-cross-bu-resource-code' }).expect(303);
    await request(app.getHttpServer()).post(`/api/bff/instagram-authorizations/${authorization.body.id}/confirm`)
      .set('cookie', otherBuCookie).set('x-requested-with', 'teste').set('idempotency-key', randomUUID()).send({}).expect(409);

    expect(Buffer.from((await prisma.channelCredential.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { channelId: original.id } })).ciphertext).toString('hex')).toBe(originalCiphertext);

  it('CP2-IDEMPOTENCY: preserves the actor budget in PostgreSQL and returns Retry-After without provider calls', async () => {
    const budgetTenant = await criarMantenedora(app, 'Instagram CP2 budgets', 'instagram-cp2-budget-owner@example.test');
    const budgetBuId = budgetTenant.businessUnit.id;
    const actorCookies = [await login(app, 'instagram-cp2-budget-owner@example.test')];
    const actorEmails = ['instagram-cp2-budget-admin-one@example.test', 'instagram-cp2-budget-admin-two@example.test'];
    for (let index = 0; index < actorEmails.length; index += 1) {
      await criarUsuario(prisma, budgetTenant.mantenedora.id, budgetBuId, actorEmails[index], 'ADMIN');
      actorCookies.push(await login(app, actorEmails[index]));
    }
    const callsBefore = instagramFake.calls.length;
    for (const [actorIndex, actorCookie] of actorCookies.entries()) {
      for (let index = 0; index < 10; index += 1) {
        await request(app.getHttpServer()).post(`/api/bff/business-units/${budgetBuId}/instagram-authorizations`)
          .set('cookie', actorCookie).set('x-requested-with', 'teste').set('idempotency-key', randomUUID()).send({ operation: 'CONNECT' }).expect(201);
      }
      if (actorIndex === 0) {
        const budgetOwner = await prisma.appUser.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { mantenedoraId_email: { mantenedoraId: budgetTenant.mantenedora.id, email: 'instagram-cp2-budget-owner@example.test' } }, select: { id: true } });
        const oldestActorAttempt = await prisma.instagramAuthorizationAttempt.findFirstOrThrow({ where: { buId: budgetBuId, userId: budgetOwner.id }, orderBy: { createdAt: 'asc' } });
        await prisma.instagramAuthorizationAttempt.update({ where: { id: oldestActorAttempt.id }, data: { createdAt: new Date(Date.now() - 59 * 60_000) } });
        const actorBudget = await request(app.getHttpServer()).post(`/api/bff/business-units/${budgetBuId}/instagram-authorizations`)
          .set('cookie', actorCookie).set('x-requested-with', 'teste').set('idempotency-key', randomUUID()).send({ operation: 'CONNECT' }).expect(429);
        expect(Number(actorBudget.headers['retry-after'])).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(50);
        expect(Number(actorBudget.headers['retry-after'])).toBeLessThanOrEqual(65);
        expect(await prisma.instagramAuthorizationAttempt.count({ where: { buId: budgetBuId } })).toBe(10);
      }
    }
    expect(await prisma.instagramAuthorizationAttempt.count({ where: { buId: budgetBuId } })).toBe(30);
    const fourthAdminEmail = 'instagram-cp2-budget-admin-four@example.test';
    await criarUsuario(prisma, budgetTenant.mantenedora.id, budgetBuId, fourthAdminEmail, 'ADMIN');
    const fourthAdminCookie = await login(app, fourthAdminEmail);
    const oldestBuAttempt = await prisma.instagramAuthorizationAttempt.findFirstOrThrow({ where: { buId: budgetBuId }, orderBy: { createdAt: 'asc' } });
    await prisma.instagramAuthorizationAttempt.update({ where: { id: oldestBuAttempt.id }, data: { createdAt: new Date(Date.now() - 59 * 60_000) } });
    const buBudget = await request(app.getHttpServer()).post(`/api/bff/business-units/${budgetBuId}/instagram-authorizations`)
      .set('cookie', fourthAdminCookie).set('x-requested-with', 'teste').set('idempotency-key', randomUUID()).send({ operation: 'CONNECT' }).expect(429);
    expect(Number(buBudget.headers['retry-after'])).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(50);
    expect(Number(buBudget.headers['retry-after'])).toBeLessThanOrEqual(65);
    expect(await prisma.instagramAuthorizationAttempt.count({ where: { buId: budgetBuId } })).toBe(30);
    expect(instagramFake.calls).toHaveLength(callsBefore);
  });

  it('authenticates raw bytes before domain writes, accepts text through shared PostgreSQL acceptance, and deduplicates replay', async () => {
    const messagesBefore = await prisma.message.count();
    const conversationsBefore = await prisma.conversation.count();
    const routesBefore = await prisma.conversationRoute.count();
    const body = JSON.stringify({ object: 'instagram', entry: [{
      id: professionalId, time: Date.now(), messaging: [{ sender: { id: 'opaque-peer-ig-77', username: 'mutable_name' },
        recipient: { id: professionalId }, timestamp: Date.now(), message: { mid: 'ig-mid-cp2-001', text: 'Olá pelo Instagram' } }],
    }] });
    const signature = `sha256=${createHmac('sha256', INSTAGRAM_WEBHOOK_SECRET).update(body).digest('hex')}`;
    const send = (raw: string, signed = signature) => request(app.getHttpServer()).post('/webhooks/instagram')
      .set('content-type', 'application/json').set('x-hub-signature-256', signed).send(raw);

    await send(body, `sha256=${'0'.repeat(64)}`).expect(401);
    expect(await prisma.message.count()).toBe(messagesBefore);
    const accepted = await send(body).expect(200);
    expect(accepted.text).toBe('EVENT_RECEIVED');
    const overlappingReplays = await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: 20 }, () => send(body)));
    expect(overlappingReplays.every((response) => response.status === 200 && response.text === 'EVENT_RECEIVED')).toBe(true);
    expect(await prisma.message.count()).toBe(messagesBefore + 1);
    expect(await prisma.conversation.count()).toBe(conversationsBefore + 1);
    expect(await prisma.conversationRoute.count()).toBe(routesBefore + 1);
    const route = await prisma.conversationRoute.findFirstOrThrow({ where: { contactIdentity: { externalPeerId: 'opaque-peer-ig-77' } }, include: { businessIdentity: true, contactIdentity: true } });
    expect(route.businessIdentity.externalResourceId).toBe(professionalId);
    expect(route.contactIdentity.externalPeerId).toBe('opaque-peer-ig-77');
    expect(route.businessIdentity.platform).toBe('INSTAGRAM');
    expect(route.contactIdentity.platform).toBe('INSTAGRAM');
    const message = await prisma.message.findFirstOrThrow({ where: { externalId: 'ig-mid-cp2-001' }, include: { conversation: true } });
    expect(message.content).toBe('Olá pelo Instagram');
    expect(message.direction).toBe('IN');
    expect(message.officialInboundAt).not.toBeNull();
    const connectedChannel = await prisma.buChannel.findFirstOrThrow({ where: { buId, type: 'INSTAGRAM' }, include: { credential: true } });
    expect(connectedChannel.status).toBe('CONECTADO');
    const connectedReceipt = connectedChannel.receiptVerifiedAt;
    const priorSubscriptionPosts = instagramFake.calls.filter((call) => call.method === 'POST' && call.url.endsWith('/subscribed_apps')).length;
    const priorMessageCount = await prisma.message.count({ where: { conversation: { is: { routes: { some: { businessIdentityId: connectedChannel.businessIdentityId } } } } } });
    const reauthorization = await request(app.getHttpServer()).post(`/api/bff/business-units/${buId}/instagram-authorizations`)
      .set('cookie', cookie).set('x-requested-with', 'teste').set('idempotency-key', randomUUID())
      .send({ operation: 'REAUTHORIZE', channelId: connectedChannel.id, expectedGeneration: connectedChannel.generation }).expect(201);
    await request(app.getHttpServer()).get('/api/bff/instagram-authorizations/callback').set('cookie', cookie)
      .query({ state: new URL(reauthorization.body.authorizationUrl).searchParams.get('state'), code: 'synthetic-connected-reauthorization-code' }).expect(303);
    const reauthorizationConfirmation = await request(app.getHttpServer()).post(`/api/bff/instagram-authorizations/${reauthorization.body.id}/confirm`)
      .set('cookie', cookie).set('x-requested-with', 'teste').set('idempotency-key', randomUUID())
      .send({ expectedGeneration: connectedChannel.generation }).expect(200);
    expect(reauthorizationConfirmation.body.subscriptionState).toBe('SUBSCRIBED');
    expect(instagramFake.calls.filter((call) => call.method === 'POST' && call.url.endsWith('/subscribed_apps'))).toHaveLength(priorSubscriptionPosts);
    const reauthorizedChannel = await prisma.buChannel.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: connectedChannel.id } });
    expect(reauthorizedChannel.status).toBe('CONECTADO');
    expect(reauthorizedChannel.receiptVerifiedAt).toEqual(connectedReceipt);
    expect(await prisma.message.count({ where: { conversation: { is: { routes: { some: { businessIdentityId: connectedChannel.businessIdentityId } } } } } })).toBe(priorMessageCount);
    expect(message.conversation.unreadCount).toBe(1);
    const channel = await prisma.buChannel.findFirstOrThrow({ where: { buId, type: 'INSTAGRAM' } });
    expect(channel.status).toBe('CONECTADO');
    expect(channel.receiptVerifiedAt).not.toBeNull();

    const alteredBytes = body.replace('Olá pelo Instagram', 'Ola pelo Instagram');
    await send(alteredBytes).expect(401);
    const wrongSecret = `sha256=${createHmac('sha256', 'segredo-do-app-meta').update(body).digest('hex')}`;
    await send(body, wrongSecret).expect(401);
    expect(await prisma.message.count()).toBe(messagesBefore + 1);
    expect(await prisma.conversationRoute.count()).toBe(routesBefore + 1);
  });

  it('preflights the whole batch and ignores echo/read events without opening receipt or creating messages', async () => {
    const messagesBefore = await prisma.message.count();
    const conversationsBefore = await prisma.conversation.count();
    const routesBefore = await prisma.conversationRoute.count({ where: { buId } });
    const contactsBefore = await prisma.contactIdentity.count({ where: { buId, platform: 'INSTAGRAM' } });
    const unreadBefore = (await prisma.conversation.aggregate({ _sum: { unreadCount: true } }))._sum.unreadCount ?? 0;
    const validUpdates = Array.from({ length: 1000 }, (_, index) => ({ sender: { id: `opaque-batch-peer-${index}` }, recipient: { id: professionalId },
      timestamp: Date.now(), message: { mid: `ig-mid-cp2-batch-${index}`, text: 'bounded fixture' } }));
    const validBatch = JSON.stringify({ object: 'instagram', entry: [{ id: professionalId, messaging: validUpdates }] });
    const validSignature = `sha256=${createHmac('sha256', INSTAGRAM_WEBHOOK_SECRET).update(validBatch).digest('hex')}`;
    const initialStartedAt = process.hrtime.bigint();
    console.log(`[IG-BATCH-PHASE]${JSON.stringify({ phase: 'initial-started', updates: 1000 })}`);
    const acceptedBatch = await request(app.getHttpServer()).post('/webhooks/instagram').set('content-type', 'application/json')
      .set('x-hub-signature-256', validSignature).send(validBatch).expect(200);
    const initialElapsedMs = Number(process.hrtime.bigint() - initialStartedAt) / 1_000_000;
    console.log(`[IG-BATCH-PHASE]${JSON.stringify({ phase: 'initial-completed', updates: 1000, elapsedMs: Number(initialElapsedMs.toFixed(3)) })}`);
    expect(initialElapsedMs).toBeLessThanOrEqual(15_000);
    expect(acceptedBatch.text).toBe('EVENT_RECEIVED');
    expect(await prisma.message.count()).toBe(messagesBefore + 1000);
    expect(await prisma.conversation.count()).toBe(conversationsBefore + 1000);
    expect(await prisma.conversationRoute.count({ where: { buId } })).toBe(routesBefore + 1000);
    expect(await prisma.contactIdentity.count({ where: { buId, platform: 'INSTAGRAM' } })).toBe(contactsBefore + 1000);
    expect((await prisma.conversation.aggregate({ _sum: { unreadCount: true } }))._sum.unreadCount).toBe(unreadBefore + 1000);
    const replayStartedAt = process.hrtime.bigint();
    console.log(`[IG-BATCH-PHASE]${JSON.stringify({ phase: 'replay-started', updates: 1000 })}`);
    await request(app.getHttpServer()).post('/webhooks/instagram').set('content-type', 'application/json')
      .set('x-hub-signature-256', validSignature).send(validBatch).expect(200);
    const replayElapsedMs = Number(process.hrtime.bigint() - replayStartedAt) / 1_000_000;
    console.log(`[IG-BATCH-PHASE]${JSON.stringify({ phase: 'replay-completed', updates: 1000, elapsedMs: Number(replayElapsedMs.toFixed(3)) })}`);
    expect(await prisma.message.count()).toBe(messagesBefore + 1000);
    expect(await prisma.conversation.count()).toBe(conversationsBefore + 1000);
    expect(await prisma.conversationRoute.count({ where: { buId } })).toBe(routesBefore + 1000);

  it('CP2-CANCEL: a stale reauthorization candidate can be cancelled without changing active ownership or message facts', async () => {
    const channel = await prisma.buChannel.findFirstOrThrow({ where: { buId, businessIdentity: { externalResourceId: professionalId } }, include: { credential: true } });
    const encryptedBefore = Buffer.from(channel.credential!.ciphertext).toString('hex');
    const messageCount = await prisma.message.count({ where: { providerResourceIdentity: { externalResourceId: professionalId } } });
    instagramFake.meEnvelope = { user_id: 'synthetic-second-professional-ig-id', username: 'wrong_reauth_account' };
    const wrongAccount = await request(app.getHttpServer()).post(`/api/bff/business-units/${buId}/instagram-authorizations`)
      .set('cookie', cookie).set('x-requested-with', 'teste').set('idempotency-key', randomUUID())
      .send({ operation: 'REAUTHORIZE', channelId: channel.id, expectedGeneration: channel.generation }).expect(201);
    await request(app.getHttpServer()).get('/api/bff/instagram-authorizations/callback').set('cookie', cookie)
      .query({ state: new URL(wrongAccount.body.authorizationUrl).searchParams.get('state'), code: 'synthetic-wrong-reauth-account-code' }).expect(303);
    await request(app.getHttpServer()).post(`/api/bff/instagram-authorizations/${wrongAccount.body.id}/confirm`)
      .set('cookie', cookie).set('x-requested-with', 'teste').set('idempotency-key', randomUUID()).send({ expectedGeneration: channel.generation }).expect(409);
    await request(app.getHttpServer()).post(`/api/bff/instagram-authorizations/${wrongAccount.body.id}/cancel`)
      .set('cookie', cookie).set('x-requested-with', 'teste').send({}).expect(200);
    instagramFake.meEnvelope = null;

    const authorization = await request(app.getHttpServer()).post(`/api/bff/business-units/${buId}/instagram-authorizations`)
      .set('cookie', cookie).set('x-requested-with', 'teste').set('idempotency-key', randomUUID())
      .send({ operation: 'REAUTHORIZE', channelId: channel.id, expectedGeneration: channel.generation }).expect(201);
    await request(app.getHttpServer()).get('/api/bff/instagram-authorizations/callback').set('cookie', cookie)
      .query({ state: new URL(authorization.body.authorizationUrl).searchParams.get('state'), code: 'synthetic-cancellable-code' }).expect(303);
    const beforeCalls = instagramFake.calls.length;
    await request(app.getHttpServer()).post(`/api/bff/instagram-authorizations/${authorization.body.id}/confirm`)
      .set('cookie', cookie).set('x-requested-with', 'teste').set('idempotency-key', randomUUID()).send({ expectedGeneration: channel.generation + 1 }).expect(409);
    const cancelled = await request(app.getHttpServer()).post(`/api/bff/instagram-authorizations/${authorization.body.id}/cancel`)
      .set('cookie', cookie).set('x-requested-with', 'teste').send({}).expect(200);
    expect(cancelled.body.status).toBe('CANCELLED');
    expect(instagramFake.calls).toHaveLength(beforeCalls);
    const current = await prisma.buChannel.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: channel.id }, include: { credential: true, businessIdentity: true } });
    expect(current.status).toBe('CONECTADO');
    expect(current.businessIdentity.externalResourceId).toBe(professionalId);
    expect(Buffer.from(current.credential!.ciphertext).toString('hex')).toBe(encryptedBefore);
    expect(await prisma.message.count({ where: { providerResourceIdentity: { externalResourceId: professionalId } } })).toBe(messageCount);
    const attempt = await prisma.instagramAuthorizationAttempt.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: authorization.body.id } });
    expect(attempt.candidateCiphertext).toBeNull();
  });

  it('CP2-BOUNDS: enforces the OAuth 16 KiB and Instagram 8 MiB limits before any new attempt or message', async () => {
    const boundsTenant = await criarMantenedora(app, 'Instagram CP2 bounds isolation', 'instagram-cp2-bounds-owner@example.test');
    const boundsBuId = boundsTenant.businessUnit.id;
    const boundsCookie = await login(app, 'instagram-cp2-bounds-owner@example.test');
    const oauthPath = `/api/bff/business-units/${boundsBuId}/instagram-authorizations`;
    const effectiveOAuthPaths = [oauthPath, `${oauthPath}/`, oauthPath.replace('/api/bff/', '/API/BFF/')];
    const acceptedOAuthKey = randomUUID();
    for (const path of effectiveOAuthPaths) {
      await request(app.getHttpServer()).post(path)
        .set('cookie', boundsCookie).set('x-requested-with', 'teste').set('idempotency-key', acceptedOAuthKey)
        .send({ operation: 'CONNECT' }).expect(201);
    }
    const attemptsBeforeOversize = await prisma.instagramAuthorizationAttempt.count({ where: { buId: boundsBuId } });
    const whitespacePaddedOAuth = `${JSON.stringify({ operation: 'CONNECT' })}${' '.repeat(17 * 1024)}`;
    for (const path of effectiveOAuthPaths) {
      await request(app.getHttpServer()).post(path)
        .set('cookie', boundsCookie).set('x-requested-with', 'teste').set('idempotency-key', randomUUID())
        .set('content-type', 'application/json').send(whitespacePaddedOAuth).expect(413);
    }
    expect(await prisma.instagramAuthorizationAttempt.count({ where: { buId: boundsBuId } })).toBe(attemptsBeforeOversize);

    const malformedEntry = JSON.stringify({ object: 'instagram', entry: [null] });
    const malformedSig = `sha256=${createHmac('sha256', INSTAGRAM_WEBHOOK_SECRET).update(malformedEntry).digest('hex')}`;
    await request(app.getHttpServer()).post('/webhooks/instagram').set('content-type', 'application/json')
      .set('x-hub-signature-256', malformedSig).send(malformedEntry).expect(403);

    const messageCount = await prisma.message.count();
    const oversizedRaw = 'x'.repeat(8 * 1024 * 1024 + 1);
    await request(app.getHttpServer()).post('/webhooks/instagram').set('content-type', 'application/json')
      .set('x-hub-signature-256', `sha256=${'0'.repeat(64)}`).send(oversizedRaw).expect(413);
    const aliasPayload = `${JSON.stringify({ object: 'instagram', entry: [] })}${' '.repeat(1024 * 1024 + 1)}`;
    const aliasSignature = `sha256=${createHmac('sha256', INSTAGRAM_WEBHOOK_SECRET).update(aliasPayload).digest('hex')}`;
    const alias = '/WEBHOOKS/INSTAGRAM/';
    const acceptedAlias = await request(app.getHttpServer()).post(alias).set('content-type', 'application/json')
      .set('x-hub-signature-256', aliasSignature).send(aliasPayload).expect(200);
    expect(acceptedAlias.text).toBe('EVENT_RECEIVED');
    await request(app.getHttpServer()).post(alias).set('content-type', 'application/json')
      .set('x-hub-signature-256', aliasSignature).send(`{ ${aliasPayload.slice(1)}`).expect(401);
    const oversizedAlias = 'x'.repeat(8 * 1024 * 1024 + 1);
    const oversizedAliasSignature = `sha256=${createHmac('sha256', INSTAGRAM_WEBHOOK_SECRET).update(oversizedAlias).digest('hex')}`;
    await request(app.getHttpServer()).post(alias).set('content-type', 'application/json')
      .set('x-hub-signature-256', oversizedAliasSignature).send(oversizedAlias).expect(413);
    expect(await prisma.message.count()).toBe(messageCount);
  });

  it('rechecks natural signed-session expiry after the real attempt UPDATE wait with an equal-duration live control', async () => {
    const sessions = app.get(SessionService);
    const holdAttempt = async (attemptId: string) => {
      let release!: () => void;
      let locked!: () => void;
      let blockerPid = 0;
      const held = new Promise<void>((resolve) => { release = resolve; });
      const acquired = new Promise<void>((resolve) => { locked = resolve; });
      const transaction = prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
        const [{ pid }] = await tx.$queryRaw<Array<{ pid: number }>>`SELECT pg_backend_pid() AS pid`;
        blockerPid = pid;
        await tx.$queryRaw`SELECT id FROM instagram_authorization_attempts WHERE id = ${attemptId} FOR UPDATE`;
        locked();
        await held;
      });
      await acquired;
      return { release, transaction, get blockerPid() { return blockerPid; } };
    };
    const awaitBlockedClaim = async (blockerPid: number): Promise<boolean> => {
      const until = Date.now() + 1200;
      while (Date.now() < until) {
        const waiters = await prisma.$queryRaw<Array<{ pid: number }>>`SELECT activity.pid FROM pg_stat_activity AS activity
          WHERE activity.wait_event_type = 'Lock' AND ${blockerPid} = ANY(pg_blocking_pids(activity.pid))
            AND activity.query ILIKE '%UPDATE instagram_authorization_attempts%'`;
        if (waiters.length > 0) return true;
        await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 10));
      }
      return false;
    };
    const makeAttempt = async (buId: string, cookie: string, key: string) => {
      const created = await request(app.getHttpServer()).post(`/api/bff/business-units/${buId}/instagram-authorizations`)
        .set('cookie', cookie).set('x-requested-with', 'teste').set('idempotency-key', randomUUID()).send({ operation: 'CONNECT' }).expect(201);
      return { id: String(created.body.id), state: new URL(created.body.authorizationUrl).searchParams.get('state')!, key };
    };

    const expiredTenant = await criarMantenedora(app, 'Instagram natural session expiry at attempt claim', 'instagram-attempt-session-expiry@example.test');
    const liveCookie = await login(app, 'instagram-attempt-session-expiry@example.test');
    const issuedAt = Date.now() - 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000 + 1800;
    const expiredToken = sessions.assinar(expiredTenant.owner.id, issuedAt);
    const expiredCookie = `${SESSION_COOKIE}=${expiredToken}`;
    await prisma.appUser.update({ where: { id: expiredTenant.owner.id }, data: { passwordChangedAt: new Date(issuedAt - 1000) } });
    expect(sessions.verificar(expiredToken)).not.toBeNull();
    const expiredAttempt = await makeAttempt(expiredTenant.businessUnit.id, expiredCookie, 'synthetic-expiring-session-callback');
    const sessionExpiresAt = issuedAt + 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
    expect(sessionExpiresAt - Date.now()).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    const expiredHold = await holdAttempt(expiredAttempt.id);
    const callsBeforeExpired = instagramFake.calls.length;
    const expiredCallbackStartedAt = performance.now();
    const expiredCallback = request(app.getHttpServer()).get('/api/bff/instagram-authorizations/callback').set('cookie', expiredCookie)
      .query({ state: expiredAttempt.state, code: expiredAttempt.key }).then((response) => response);
    let expiredWaitMs!: number;
    try {
      const expiredWaitReached = await awaitBlockedClaim(expiredHold.blockerPid);
      expect(expiredWaitReached).toBe(true);
      expect(Date.now()).toBeLessThan(sessionExpiresAt);
      while (Date.now() <= sessionExpiresAt) await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, Math.min(25, sessionExpiresAt - Date.now() + 1)));
      expect(sessions.verificar(expiredToken)).toBeNull();
      const stillBlocked = await prisma.$queryRaw<Array<{ pid: number }>>`SELECT activity.pid FROM pg_stat_activity AS activity
        WHERE activity.wait_event_type = 'Lock' AND ${expiredHold.blockerPid} = ANY(pg_blocking_pids(activity.pid))
          AND activity.query ILIKE '%UPDATE instagram_authorization_attempts%'`;
      expect(stillBlocked.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    } finally {
      expiredWaitMs = performance.now() - expiredCallbackStartedAt;
      expiredHold.release();
      await expiredHold.transaction;
    }
    const expiredResponse = await expiredCallback;
    expect(expiredWaitMs).toBeLessThan(4500);
    expect(expiredResponse.status).toBe(303);
    const expiredAfter = await prisma.instagramAuthorizationAttempt.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: expiredAttempt.id } });
    expect(expiredAfter.status).toBe('AUTHORIZATION_PENDING');
    expect(expiredAfter.callbackLeaseToken).toBeNull();
    expect(expiredAfter.expiresAt.getTime()).toBeGreaterThan(Date.now());
    expect(instagramFake.calls).toHaveLength(callsBeforeExpired);

    const liveAttempt = await makeAttempt(expiredTenant.businessUnit.id, liveCookie, 'synthetic-live-session-row-wait');
    const liveHold = await holdAttempt(liveAttempt.id);
    const callsBeforeLive = instagramFake.calls.length;
    const liveCallbackStartedAt = performance.now();
    const liveCallback = request(app.getHttpServer()).get('/api/bff/instagram-authorizations/callback').set('cookie', liveCookie)
      .query({ state: liveAttempt.state, code: liveAttempt.key }).then((response) => response);
    try {
      const liveWaitReached = await awaitBlockedClaim(liveHold.blockerPid);
      expect(liveWaitReached).toBe(true);
      const remainingMatchedHold = expiredWaitMs - (performance.now() - liveCallbackStartedAt);
      if (remainingMatchedHold > 0) await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, remainingMatchedHold));
    } finally {
      liveHold.release();
      await liveHold.transaction;
    }
    const liveResponse = await liveCallback;
    expect(Math.abs(performance.now() - liveCallbackStartedAt - expiredWaitMs)).toBeLessThan(250);
    expect(liveResponse.status).toBe(303);
    expect((await prisma.instagramAuthorizationAttempt.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: liveAttempt.id } })).status).toBe('CANDIDATE_READY');
    expect(instagramFake.calls.length - callsBeforeLive).toBe(3);
  });

          message: { mid: `ig-entry-account-invalid-${index}`, text: 'earlier valid event must not partially commit' } }],
      };

          message: { mid: `ig-entry-account-valid-${index}`, text: 'valid event before malformed account' } }] },
        invalidEntry,
      ] });
      const signature = `sha256=${createHmac('sha256', INSTAGRAM_WEBHOOK_SECRET).update(raw).digest('hex')}`;
      const invalidStatus = index === 2 ? 403 : 400;

        .set('x-hub-signature-256', signature).send(raw).expect(invalidStatus);
      expect(await prisma.message.count({ where: { externalId: { in: [`ig-entry-account-valid-${index}`, `ig-entry-account-invalid-${index}`] } } })).toBe(0);
      expect(await prisma.message.count()).toBe(before.messages);
      expect(await prisma.conversation.count()).toBe(before.conversations);
      expect(await prisma.contactIdentity.count({ where: { buId, platform: 'INSTAGRAM' } })).toBe(before.contacts);
      expect(await prisma.conversationRoute.count({ where: { buId } })).toBe(before.routes);
      expect(await prisma.providerResourceIdentity.count({ where: { buId, provider: 'INSTAGRAM' } })).toBe(before.providerResources);
      expect((await prisma.conversation.aggregate({ where: { buId }, _sum: { unreadCount: true } }))._sum.unreadCount ?? 0).toBe(before.unread);
      expect((await prisma.buChannel.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: activeChannel.id } })).receiptVerifiedAt).toEqual(before.receipt);
    }
  });

  it('CP2-R1 causal RED: cancellation wins while real PostgreSQL blocks resource promotion', async () => {
    const tenant = await criarMantenedora(app, 'Instagram cancellation promotion fixture', 'instagram-cancel-promotion@example.test');
    const actorCookie = await login(app, 'instagram-cancel-promotion@example.test');
    const accountId = 'synthetic-cancel-promotion-resource';
    const businessIdentity = await prisma.businessChannelIdentity.create({ data: {
      buId: tenant.businessUnit.id, platform: 'INSTAGRAM', namespace: 'INSTAGRAM_LOGIN',
      scopeReference: `synthetic-instagram-client-id:graph.instagram.com:${accountId}`, externalResourceId: accountId,
    } });
    const resourceIdentity = await prisma.providerResourceIdentity.create({ data: {
      provider: 'INSTAGRAM', externalResourceId: accountId, buId: tenant.businessUnit.id,
      businessIdentityId: businessIdentity.id, managedLifecycle: true, cleanupState: 'CLEANED', retiredAt: new Date(),
    } });
    instagramFake.meEnvelope = { user_id: accountId, username: 'cancel_promotion' };
    const created = await request(app.getHttpServer()).post(`/api/bff/business-units/${tenant.businessUnit.id}/instagram-authorizations`)
      .set('cookie', actorCookie).set('x-requested-with', 'teste').set('idempotency-key', randomUUID()).send({ operation: 'CONNECT' }).expect(201);
    await request(app.getHttpServer()).get('/api/bff/instagram-authorizations/callback').set('cookie', actorCookie)
      .query({ state: new URL(created.body.authorizationUrl).searchParams.get('state'), code: 'synthetic-cancel-promotion-code' }).expect(303);

    let release!: () => void;
    let entered!: () => void;
    const released = new Promise<void>((resolve) => { release = resolve; });
    const locked = new Promise<void>((resolve) => { entered = resolve; });
    const blocker = prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
      await tx.$queryRaw`SELECT id FROM provider_resource_identities WHERE id = ${resourceIdentity.id} FOR UPDATE`;
      entered();
      await released;
    }, { timeout: 30_000 });
    const beforePosts = instagramFake.calls.filter((call) => call.method === 'POST' && call.url.endsWith('/subscribed_apps')).length;
    let cancellation: Promise<{ status: number; body: { status: string } }> | null = null;
    let confirmation: Promise<{ status: number }> | null = null;
    try {
      await awaitBarrier(locked, 'resource promotion blocker');
      cancellation = request(app.getHttpServer()).post(`/api/bff/instagram-authorizations/${created.body.id}/cancel`)
        .set('cookie', actorCookie).set('x-requested-with', 'teste').send({}).then((r) => r);
      const cancelDeadline = Date.now() + 8_000;
      let cancelWaiting = false;
      while (Date.now() < cancelDeadline) {
        const rows = await prisma.$queryRaw<Array<{ waiting: boolean }>>`SELECT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE wait_event_type = 'Lock' AND query ILIKE '%provider_resource_identities%'
        ) AS waiting`;
        if (rows[0]?.waiting) { cancelWaiting = true; break; }
        await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 10));
      }
      expect(cancelWaiting).toBe(true);
      confirmation = request(app.getHttpServer()).post(`/api/bff/instagram-authorizations/${created.body.id}/confirm`)
        .set('cookie', actorCookie).set('x-requested-with', 'teste').set('idempotency-key', randomUUID()).send({}).then((r) => r);
      const confirmDeadline = Date.now() + 8_000;
      let confirmWaiting = false;
      while (Date.now() < confirmDeadline) {
        const rows = await prisma.$queryRaw<Array<{ count: number }>>`SELECT count(*)::int AS count FROM pg_stat_activity
          WHERE wait_event_type = 'Lock' AND (query ILIKE '%provider_resource_identities%' OR query ILIKE '%pg_advisory_xact_lock%')`;
        if ((rows[0]?.count ?? 0) >= 2) { confirmWaiting = true; break; }
        await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 10));
      }
      expect(confirmWaiting).toBe(true);
      release();
      await blocker;
      const cancellationResponse = await cancellation;
      expect(cancellationResponse.status).toBe(200);
      expect(cancellationResponse.body.status).toBe('CANCELLED');
      const response = await confirmation!;
      expect(response.status).toBe(409);
      expect((await prisma.instagramAuthorizationAttempt.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: created.body.id } })).status).toBe('CANCELLED');
      expect(await prisma.buChannel.count({ where: { buId: tenant.businessUnit.id, type: 'INSTAGRAM' } })).toBe(0);
      expect(await prisma.channelCredential.count({ where: { provider: 'INSTAGRAM', buId: tenant.businessUnit.id } })).toBe(0);
      expect(instagramFake.calls.filter((call) => call.method === 'POST' && call.url.endsWith('/subscribed_apps'))).toHaveLength(beforePosts);
    } finally {
      release();
      await Promise.allSettled([blocker, ...(cancellation ? [cancellation] : []), ...(confirmation ? [confirmation] : [])]);
      instagramFake.meEnvelope = null;
    }
  });

  it('CP2-R1 causal RED: preflights a malformed supported message MID before accepting an earlier valid update', async () => {
    const beforeMessages = await prisma.message.count();
    const malformed = JSON.stringify({ object: 'instagram', entry: [{ id: professionalId, messaging: [
      { sender: { id: 'opaque-mid-preflight-first' }, recipient: { id: professionalId }, timestamp: Date.now(), message: { mid: 'ig-mid-preflight-first', text: 'no partial write' } },

import { INSTAGRAM_HTTP_FETCH } from '../src/integrations/instagram/instagram-http.client';

/** Explicit synthetic WhatsApp conversation fixture with its canonical BU-local peer. */
export async function criarConversaFixture(
  prisma: PrismaService,
  data: Omit<Prisma.ConversationUncheckedCreateInput, 'contactId'>,
) {
  return prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
    const peer = await resolveOrCreateContactIdentity(tx, whatsappPeerAddress({
      buId: data.buId,
      externalPeerId: data.contact,
      contactType: data.contactType ?? 'PESSOA',
      displayName: data.displayName,
    }));
    return tx.conversation.create({ data: { ...data, contactId: peer.contactId } });
  });
}

/** Explicit route for manually seeded conversations; callers must name both endpoints. */
export async function criarRotaConversaFixture(
  prisma: PrismaService,
  input: { conversationId: string; channelId: string },
) {
  return prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
    const conversation = await tx.conversation.findUnique({ where: { id: input.conversationId }, include: { localContact: { include: { identities: true } } } });
    const channel = await tx.buChannel.findUnique({ where: { id: input.channelId }, include: { businessIdentity: true, providerIdentities: true } });
    if (!conversation || !channel || conversation.buId !== channel.buId || !channel.businessIdentityId || !channel.businessIdentity
      || channel.type === 'INSTAGRAM' || channel.businessIdentity.buId !== conversation.buId
      || channel.businessIdentity.platform !== 'WHATSAPP' || channel.businessIdentity.namespace !== 'WHATSAPP_RESOURCE'
      || channel.businessIdentity.scopeReference !== 'BU' || channel.status !== 'CONECTADO'
      || !channel.ownNumberVerified || channel.verifiedEpoch !== channel.pairingEpoch) {
      throw new Error('Explicit route fixture requires a current, verified same-BU channel and business identity.');
    }
    const peerAddress = whatsappPeerAddress({ buId: conversation.buId, externalPeerId: conversation.contact,
      contactType: conversation.contactType, displayName: conversation.displayName });
    if (peerAddress.externalPeerId !== (conversation.contactType === 'PESSOA' ? normalizeWhatsAppPersonPeer(conversation.contact) : conversation.contact.trim())) {
      throw new Error('Explicit route fixture requires a canonical WhatsApp peer.');
    }
    const identities = conversation.localContact.identities.filter((item) => item.buId === conversation.buId
      && item.contactId === conversation.contactId && item.platform === 'WHATSAPP'
      && item.namespace === peerAddress.namespace && item.scopeReference === 'BU'
      && item.externalPeerId === peerAddress.externalPeerId);
    if (identities.length !== 1) throw new Error('Explicit route fixture requires exactly one canonical WhatsApp peer identity.');
    const identity = identities[0];
    const expectedResourceId = channel.type === 'OFICIAL' ? channel.phoneNumberId : channel.evolutionInstanceName;
    const currentResources = channel.providerIdentities.filter((resource) => resource.currentChannelId === channel.id
      && resource.buId === conversation.buId && resource.businessIdentityId === channel.businessIdentityId
      && resource.provider === channel.type && resource.externalResourceId === expectedResourceId
      && resource.managedLifecycle && resource.retiredAt === null && resource.cleanupState === 'ACTIVE');
    if (!expectedResourceId || currentResources.length !== 1) {
      throw new Error('Explicit route fixture requires exactly one current matching provider resource.');
    }
    return tx.conversationRoute.create({ data: {
      buId: conversation.buId, conversationId: conversation.id, contactId: identity.contactId,
      contactIdentityId: identity.id, platform: 'WHATSAPP', contactScopeReference: identity.scopeReference,
      businessScopeReference: channel.businessIdentity.scopeReference, businessIdentityId: channel.businessIdentity.id,
    } });
  });
}

/** Fetches the native V2 route tuple for one explicitly selected channel. */
export async function obterSelecaoRespostaV2(app: INestApplication, conversationId: string, cookie: string, channelId: string) {
  const response = await request(app.getHttpServer()).get(`/api/bff/conversations/${conversationId}/reply-options`)
    .set('Cookie', cookie).expect(200);
  if (response.body.schemaVersion !== 2 || !Array.isArray(response.body.options)) throw new Error('Unexpected V2 reply-options response.');
  const matches = response.body.options.filter((option: Record<string, unknown>) => option.channelId === channelId);
  if (matches.length !== 1) throw new Error(`Expected one V2 reply option for selected channel ${channelId}; found ${matches.length}.`);
  const option = matches[0];
  if (option.schemaVersion !== 2 || typeof option.routeId !== 'string' || typeof option.channelId !== 'string'
    || typeof option.generation !== 'number' || !Number.isSafeInteger(option.generation)
    || typeof option.contextFingerprint !== 'string' || !/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/i.test(option.contextFingerprint)) {
    throw new Error('Selected reply option is missing its complete V2 route context.');
  }
  return { schemaVersion: 2, routeId: option.routeId, channelId: option.channelId,
    expectedGeneration: option.generation, contextFingerprint: option.contextFingerprint };
}

/** Explicit bulk fixture path for PostgreSQL query-bound tests with synthetic histories. */
export async function criarConversasFixtureEmLote(
  prisma: PrismaService,
  rows: readonly Omit<Prisma.ConversationUncheckedCreateInput, 'contactId'>[],
) {
  const prepared = rows.map((row) => {
    const id = row.id ?? randomUUID();
    const contactId = randomUUID();
    const address = whatsappPeerAddress({
      buId: row.buId,
      externalPeerId: row.contact,
      contactType: row.contactType ?? 'PESSOA',
      displayName: row.displayName,
    });
    return { row: { ...row, id }, contactId, identityId: randomUUID(), address };
  });
  const chunkSize = 750;
  for (let offset = 0; offset < prepared.length; offset += chunkSize) {
    const chunk = prepared.slice(offset, offset + chunkSize);
    await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
      await tx.contact.createMany({ data: chunk.map(({ row, contactId }) => ({
        id: contactId, buId: row.buId, displayName: row.displayName ?? null,
      })) });
      await tx.contactIdentity.createMany({ data: chunk.map(({ row, contactId, identityId, address }) => ({
        id: identityId, buId: row.buId, contactId, platform: address.platform,
        namespace: address.namespace, scopeReference: address.scopeReference, externalPeerId: address.externalPeerId,
      })) });
      await tx.conversation.createMany({ data: chunk.map(({ row, contactId }) => ({ ...row, contactId })) });
    });
  }
  return prepared.map(({ row }) => row);
}

/**
 * Liga o canal não oficial nos DOIS níveis: o teto da instalação (env, lido no
 * boot do serviço) e o contrato da Mantenedora (banco) — ADR-0016.
 *
 * Precisa vir ANTES de `subirApp`, porque o teto é lido uma vez na construção.
 * É o mesmo que acontece em produção: mudar módulo de instalação é deploy.
 */
export function tetoComCanalNaoOficial(): void {
  process.env.LH_CHANNEL_UNOFFICIAL = 'true';
}

export async function contratarCanalNaoOficial(prisma: PrismaService, mantenedoraId: string): Promise<void> {
  await prisma.mantenedoraSettings.upsert({
    where: { mantenedoraId },
    create: { mantenedoraId, modulos: { canalNaoOficial: true } },
    update: { modulos: { canalNaoOficial: true } },
  });
}

  messages: [] as { accountId: string; recipientId: string; text: string }[],

  subscribed: false, failNext: false, redirectNext: false,
  shortEnvelope: null as unknown, longEnvelope: null as unknown, meEnvelope: null as unknown,
  subscribedEnvelope: null as unknown, subscribeEnvelope: null as unknown, failAfterSubscription: false,

const instagramFetch: typeof fetch = async (input, init) => {

    body = (instagramFake.shortEnvelope ?? { data: [{ access_token: 'synthetic-short-token', user_id: 'synthetic-app-scoped-authref', permissions: 'instagram_business_basic,instagram_business_manage_messages' }] }) as Record<string, unknown>;

  } else if (url.hostname === 'graph.instagram.com' && url.pathname.endsWith('/subscribed_apps') && method === 'GET') {

  } else if (url.hostname === 'graph.instagram.com' && url.pathname.endsWith('/subscribed_apps') && method === 'POST') {
    instagramFake.subscribed = true;

    if (Object.keys(envelope).sort().join(',') !== 'message,recipient' || !envelope.recipient || typeof envelope.recipient !== 'object'

    const message = envelope.message as Record<string, unknown>;
    if (Object.keys(recipient).sort().join(',') !== 'id' || typeof recipient.id !== 'string'

export async function subirApp(registryOverride?: ChannelAdapterRegistry, captureQueries = false): Promise<{ app: INestApplication; prisma: PrismaService }> {
  process.env.SESSION_SECRET ||= 'segredo-de-teste';
  process.env.INTERNAL_SERVICE_TOKEN = TOKEN_INTERNO;
  process.env.META_APP_ID = 'fixture-app';
  process.env.META_APP_SECRET = META_APP_SECRET;
  process.env.META_SIGNUP_CONFIG_ID = 'fixture-config';
  process.env.GRAPH_VERSION = 'v26.0';
  process.env.EVOLUTION_WEBHOOK_SECRET = EVOLUTION_WEBHOOK_SECRET;
  process.env.EVOLUTION_WEBHOOK_URL = 'https://api.example.test/webhooks/evolution';
  process.env.WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN = 'verify-token-de-teste';
  process.env.CHANNEL_CREDENTIAL_KEY_ID = 'fixture-key-v1';
  process.env.CHANNEL_CREDENTIAL_KEY = Buffer.alloc(32, 17).toString('base64');
  process.env.INSTAGRAM_CLIENT_ID = 'synthetic-instagram-client-id';
  process.env.INSTAGRAM_CLIENT_SECRET = 'synthetic-instagram-client-secret';
  process.env.INSTAGRAM_REDIRECT_URI = 'https://api.example.test/api/bff/instagram-authorizations/callback';
  process.env.INSTAGRAM_API_VERSION = 'v26.0';
  process.env.INSTAGRAM_WEBHOOK_APP_SECRET = INSTAGRAM_WEBHOOK_SECRET;
  process.env.INSTAGRAM_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN = 'synthetic-instagram-verify-token';

  const testingModule = Test.createTestingModule({ imports: [AppModule] })
    .overrideProvider(META_CLIENT)
    .useValue(metaFake)
    .overrideProvider(EVOLUTION_CLIENT)
    .useValue(evolutionFake)
    .overrideProvider(TYPEBOT_CLIENT)
    .useValue(typebotFake)
    .overrideProvider(INSTAGRAM_HTTP_FETCH)
    .useValue(instagramFetch);
  if (captureQueries) {
    testingModule.overrideProvider(PrismaService).useValue(new PrismaService({ log: [{ emit: 'event', level: 'query' }] }));
  }
  if (registryOverride) testingModule.overrideProvider(ChannelAdapterRegistry).useValue(registryOverride);
  const moduleRef = await testingModule.compile();
  // A MESMA fiação de produção: sem isto o corpo bruto não existe e o teste de
  // assinatura passaria a provar outra coisa.
  const app = moduleRef.createNestApplication({ bodyParser: false });
  configurarBodyParsers(app as unknown as NestExpressApplication);
  await app.init();
  return { app, prisma: app.get(PrismaService) };
}

/** Limpa na ordem das dependências — o banco de teste é real (ADR-0012 §4). */
/** Cria um usuário com papel escolhido numa BU — para o caso "papel insuficiente". */
export async function criarUsuario(
  prisma: PrismaService,
  mantenedoraId: string,
  buId: string,
  email: string,
  role: 'OWNER' | 'ADMIN' | 'ATENDENTE',
  senha = 'senha-de-teste-1',
): Promise<string> {
  const bcrypt = await import('bcryptjs');
  const user = await prisma.appUser.create({
    data: {
      mantenedoraId,
      name: email,
      email,
      passwordHash: await bcrypt.default.hash(senha, 10),
    },
  });
  await prisma.userBuRole.create({ data: { userId: user.id, buId, role, grantedViaTipo: 'DIRETO' } });
  return user.id;
}

export async function criarCanalVerificado(
  prisma: PrismaService,
  buId: string,
  type: 'OFICIAL' | 'NAO_OFICIAL',
  externalResourceId: string,
  options: { status?: 'CONECTADO' | 'CONECTANDO' | 'DESCONECTADO'; requiresWindow?: boolean; provedBusinessPhone?: string; provedWabaId?: string } = {},
) {
  const priorBusinessIdentity = await prisma.businessChannelIdentity.findFirst({ where: { buId, platform: 'WHATSAPP' } });
  if (priorBusinessIdentity && options.provedBusinessPhone && priorBusinessIdentity.externalResourceId !== options.provedBusinessPhone) {
    throw new Error('Synthetic provider proof does not match the retained WhatsApp business resource.');
  }
  const businessResourceId = options.provedBusinessPhone ?? priorBusinessIdentity?.externalResourceId ?? `55${buId.replace(/\D/g, '').slice(-13)}`;
  const businessIdentity = priorBusinessIdentity ?? await prisma.businessChannelIdentity.upsert({
    where: { platform_namespace_externalResourceId: { platform: 'WHATSAPP', namespace: 'WHATSAPP_RESOURCE', externalResourceId: businessResourceId } },
    create: { buId, platform: 'WHATSAPP', namespace: 'WHATSAPP_RESOURCE', scopeReference: 'BU', externalResourceId: businessResourceId },
    update: {},
  });
  if (businessIdentity.buId !== buId) throw new Error('Synthetic WhatsApp business resource is owned by another BU.');
  const channel = await prisma.buChannel.create({ data: {
    buId, businessIdentityId: businessIdentity.id, type, status: options.status ?? 'CONECTADO', requiresWindow: options.requiresWindow ?? type === 'OFICIAL',
    ...(type === 'OFICIAL' ? { phoneNumberId: externalResourceId } : { evolutionInstanceName: externalResourceId }),
    ...(type === 'OFICIAL' ? { wabaId: options.provedWabaId ?? null } : {}),
    ownNumberVerified: true, verifiedEpoch: 0, providerConnectionState: type === 'OFICIAL' ? 'SUBSCRIBED' : 'CONNECTED',
    receiptVerifiedAt: new Date(),
  } });
  const priorIdentity = await prisma.providerResourceIdentity.findUnique({
    where: { provider_externalResourceId: { provider: type, externalResourceId } },
  });
  if (priorIdentity && (priorIdentity.buId !== buId || priorIdentity.currentChannelId)) {
    throw new Error('Fixture resource identity is owned or active elsewhere.');
  }
  const identity = priorIdentity
    ? await prisma.providerResourceIdentity.update({ where: { id: priorIdentity.id }, data: { currentChannelId: channel.id, businessIdentityId: businessIdentity.id, retiredAt: null, managedLifecycle: true, cleanupState: 'ACTIVE' } })
    : await prisma.providerResourceIdentity.create({ data: {
      provider: type, externalResourceId, buId, currentChannelId: channel.id, businessIdentityId: businessIdentity.id, managedLifecycle: true, cleanupState: 'ACTIVE',
    } });
  if (type === 'OFICIAL') {
    const keyId = process.env.CHANNEL_CREDENTIAL_KEY_ID!;
    const key = Buffer.from(process.env.CHANNEL_CREDENTIAL_KEY!, 'base64');
    const envelope = sealChannelCredential('fixture-scoped-token', keyId, key, {
      purpose: 'active', provider: type, buId, channelId: channel.id, generation: channel.generation, version: 1,
    });
    await prisma.channelCredential.create({ data: {
      channelId: channel.id, provider: type, buId, generation: channel.generation, version: 1,
      keyId, nonce: new Uint8Array(envelope.nonce), ciphertext: new Uint8Array(envelope.ciphertext), tag: new Uint8Array(envelope.tag),
    } });
  }
  return { channel, identity };
}

/** Cria uma Mantenedora pela superfície interna — o caminho real de bootstrap. */
/**
 * Cria a Mantenedora **com o onboarding já concluído**.
 *
 * O bootstrap a cria PENDENTE (ADR-0016 §4), e é assim em produção. Os testes
 * que exercitam o produto vêm depois do wizard; quem exercita o portão é
 * `onboarding.e2e-spec.ts`, que usa `criarMantenedoraPendente`.
 */
export async function criarMantenedora(
  app: INestApplication,
  nome: string,
  email: string,
  senha = 'senha-de-teste-1',
) {
  const r = await criarMantenedoraPendente(app, nome, email, senha);
  const prisma = app.get(PrismaService);
  await prisma.mantenedoraSettings.update({
    where: { mantenedoraId: r.mantenedora.id },
    data: { onboardingConcluido: true },
  });
  return r;
}

export async function criarMantenedoraPendente(
  app: INestApplication,
  nome: string,
  email: string,
  senha = 'senha-de-teste-1',
) {
  const res = await request(app.getHttpServer())
    .post('/api/internal/mantenedoras')
    .set('x-internal-token', TOKEN_INTERNO)
    .set('x-requested-with', 'teste')
    .send({ nome, bu: { nome: `Número da ${nome}`, telefone: '5584999990000' }, owner: { nome: 'Dono', email, senha } })
    .expect(201);
  return res.body as {
    mantenedora: { id: string; nome: string };
    businessUnit: { id: string; nome: string };
    owner: { id: string; email: string };
  };
}

/** Faz login e devolve o cookie de sessão para reusar nas próximas chamadas. */
export async function login(app: INestApplication, email: string, senha = 'senha-de-teste-1'): Promise<string> {
  const res = await request(app.getHttpServer())
    .post('/api/bff/auth/login')
    .set('x-requested-with', 'teste')
    .send({ email, senha })
    .expect(200);
  const setCookie = res.headers['set-cookie'] as unknown as string[];
  return setCookie[0].split(';')[0];
}

import { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
import type { ChannelAdapterOrigin, ChannelMessageKind } from '../channels/transport/channel';
import type { PrismaService } from '../../infra/prisma/prisma.service';
import { OfficialChannelWindowPolicy, officialWindowState, type OfficialWindowReference, type OfficialWindowState } from './channel-window-policy';

export type ChannelOperationKind = 'REPLY' | 'INITIAL' | 'AUTOMATION';

export interface ChannelEligibilityInput {
  readonly operation: ChannelOperationKind;
  readonly humanActor: boolean;
  readonly kind: ChannelMessageKind;
  readonly inboundWindowOpen: boolean;
}

export interface ChannelEligibilityResult {
  readonly eligible: boolean;
  readonly reason: 'AVAILABLE' | 'UNSUPPORTED_KIND' | 'WINDOW_UNQUALIFIED' | 'WINDOW_CLOSED' | 'HUMAN_REPLY_REQUIRED';
}

export type ChannelWindowReference = OfficialWindowReference;

/** Domain contract for operation-specific eligibility and its current resource window. */
export abstract class ChannelEligibilityPolicy {
  abstract readonly origin: ChannelAdapterOrigin;
  abstract readonly requiresWindow: boolean;
  abstract inspect(reference: ChannelWindowReference, tx?: Prisma.TransactionClient): Promise<OfficialWindowState>;
  abstract inspectMany(references: readonly ChannelWindowReference[], tx?: Prisma.TransactionClient): Promise<Map<string, OfficialWindowState>>;
  abstract evaluate(input: ChannelEligibilityInput): ChannelEligibilityResult;

  protected available(input: ChannelEligibilityInput): ChannelEligibilityResult {
    if (input.kind !== 'text') return { eligible: false, reason: 'UNSUPPORTED_KIND' };
    if (!input.inboundWindowOpen) return { eligible: false, reason: 'WINDOW_CLOSED' };
    return { eligible: true, reason: 'AVAILABLE' };
  }
}

export class OfficialEligibilityPolicy extends ChannelEligibilityPolicy {
  readonly origin = 'OFICIAL' as const;
  readonly requiresWindow = true;
  constructor(private readonly windows: OfficialChannelWindowPolicy) { super(); }
  inspect(reference: ChannelWindowReference, tx?: Prisma.TransactionClient): Promise<OfficialWindowState> {
    return tx ? this.windows.inspectInTransaction(tx, reference) : this.windows.inspect(reference);
  }
  async inspectMany(references: readonly ChannelWindowReference[], tx?: Prisma.TransactionClient): Promise<Map<string, OfficialWindowState>> {
    const uniqueByPair = new Map(references.map((reference) => [this.key(reference), reference]));
    const uniqueReferences = [...uniqueByPair.values()];
    if (tx) {
      const rows = await Promise.all(uniqueReferences.map(async (reference) => [
        this.key(reference), await this.windows.inspectInTransaction(tx, reference),
      ] as const));
      return new Map(rows);
    }
    const firstByConversation = new Map<string, ChannelWindowReference>();
    const duplicates: ChannelWindowReference[] = [];
    for (const reference of uniqueReferences) {
      if (firstByConversation.has(reference.conversationId)) duplicates.push(reference);
      else firstByConversation.set(reference.conversationId, reference);
    }
    const firstReferences = [...firstByConversation.values()];
    const states = await this.windows.inspectMany(firstReferences);
    const output = new Map(firstReferences.map((reference) => [
      this.key(reference), states.get(reference.conversationId) ?? { open: false, expiresAt: null },
    ]));
    for (const reference of duplicates) output.set(this.key(reference), await this.windows.inspect(reference));
    return output;
  }
  evaluate(input: ChannelEligibilityInput): ChannelEligibilityResult {
    if (input.kind === 'approved-template') {
      return input.operation === 'INITIAL'
        ? { eligible: true, reason: 'AVAILABLE' }
        : { eligible: false, reason: 'UNSUPPORTED_KIND' };
    }
    return this.available(input);
  }
  private key(reference: ChannelWindowReference) { return JSON.stringify([reference.conversationId, reference.providerResourceIdentityId]); }
}

export class EvolutionEligibilityPolicy extends ChannelEligibilityPolicy {
  readonly origin = 'NAO_OFICIAL' as const;
  readonly requiresWindow = false;
  async inspect(): Promise<OfficialWindowState> { return { open: true, expiresAt: null }; }
  async inspectMany(references: readonly ChannelWindowReference[]): Promise<Map<string, OfficialWindowState>> {
    return new Map(references.map((reference) => [JSON.stringify([reference.conversationId, reference.providerResourceIdentityId]), { open: true, expiresAt: null }]));
  }
  evaluate(input: ChannelEligibilityInput) {
    return input.kind === 'text' ? { eligible: true, reason: 'AVAILABLE' as const } : { eligible: false, reason: 'UNSUPPORTED_KIND' as const };
  }
}

/** Instagram opens only from a qualified original inbound text for the exact pair. */
export class InstagramEligibilityPolicy extends ChannelEligibilityPolicy {
  readonly origin = 'INSTAGRAM' as const;
  readonly requiresWindow = true;
  constructor(private readonly prisma: PrismaService) { super(); }

  async inspect(reference: ChannelWindowReference, tx?: Prisma.TransactionClient): Promise<OfficialWindowState> {
    return (await this.inspectMany([reference], tx)).get(this.key(reference)) ?? { open: false, expiresAt: null };
  }

  async inspectMany(references: readonly ChannelWindowReference[], tx?: Prisma.TransactionClient): Promise<Map<string, OfficialWindowState>> {
    const output = new Map<string, OfficialWindowState>();
    if (!references.length) return output;
    const uniqueReferences = [...new Map(references.map((reference) => [this.key(reference), reference])).values()];
    if (uniqueReferences.length > 100) {
      return new Map(references.map((reference) => [this.key(reference), { open: false, expiresAt: null }]));
    }
    const conversationIds = uniqueReferences.map(({ conversationId }) => conversationId);
    const resourceIds = uniqueReferences.map(({ providerResourceIdentityId }) => providerResourceIdentityId);
    const client = tx ?? this.prisma;
    const rows = await client.$queryRaw<Array<{ conversation_id: string; provider_resource_identity_id: string; inbound_at: Date | null; now: Date }>>`
      SELECT requested.conversation_id, requested.provider_resource_identity_id, latest.official_inbound_at AS inbound_at,
        clock_timestamp() AS now
      FROM unnest(ARRAY[${Prisma.join(conversationIds)}]::text[], ARRAY[${Prisma.join(resourceIds)}]::text[])
        AS requested(conversation_id, provider_resource_identity_id)
      LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT message.official_inbound_at
        FROM messages AS message
        WHERE message.conversation_id = requested.conversation_id
          AND message.provider_resource_identity_id = requested.provider_resource_identity_id
          AND message.direction = 'IN' AND message.channel_origin = 'INSTAGRAM'::"ChannelType"
          AND message.message_type = 'TEXTO'::"MessageType" AND message.content IS NOT NULL
          AND btrim(message.content) <> ''
          AND message.official_inbound_at IS NOT NULL AND message.official_inbound_at <= clock_timestamp()
        ORDER BY message.official_inbound_at DESC, message.id DESC
        LIMIT 1
      ) AS latest ON TRUE
    `;
    const byPair = new Map(rows.map((row) => [this.key({ conversationId: row.conversation_id, providerResourceIdentityId: row.provider_resource_identity_id }), officialWindowState(row.inbound_at, row.now)]));
    for (const reference of uniqueReferences) output.set(this.key(reference), byPair.get(this.key(reference)) ?? { open: false, expiresAt: null });
    return output;
  }

  evaluate(input: ChannelEligibilityInput): ChannelEligibilityResult {
    if (input.operation !== 'REPLY' || !input.humanActor) return { eligible: false, reason: 'HUMAN_REPLY_REQUIRED' };
    if (input.kind !== 'text') return { eligible: false, reason: 'UNSUPPORTED_KIND' };
    return this.available(input);
  }

  private key(reference: ChannelWindowReference) { return JSON.stringify([reference.conversationId, reference.providerResourceIdentityId]); }
}

/** Runtime composition map. Every origin must have one concrete policy. */
export class ChannelEligibilityPolicyRegistry {
  private readonly policies: ReadonlyMap<ChannelAdapterOrigin, ChannelEligibilityPolicy>;
  constructor(policies: readonly ChannelEligibilityPolicy[]) {
    const entries = policies.map((policy) => [policy.origin, policy] as const);
    if (entries.length !== 3 || new Set(entries.map(([origin]) => origin)).size !== entries.length) {
      throw new Error('Channel eligibility policy registration must cover each channel origin exactly once.');
    }
    this.policies = new Map(entries);
  }
  get(origin: ChannelAdapterOrigin): ChannelEligibilityPolicy {
    const policy = this.policies.get(origin);
    if (!policy) throw new Error(`Missing channel eligibility policy for ${origin}.`);
    return policy;
  }
  async inspectMany(references: readonly (ChannelWindowReference & { origin: ChannelAdapterOrigin })[]) {
    const grouped = new Map<ChannelAdapterOrigin, ChannelWindowReference[]>();
    for (const { origin, ...reference } of references) grouped.set(origin, [...(grouped.get(origin) ?? []), reference]);
    const output = new Map<string, OfficialWindowState>();
    for (const [origin, group] of grouped) {
      const states = await this.get(origin).inspectMany(group);
      for (const [key, state] of states) output.set(key, state);
    }
    return output;
  }
  key(reference: ChannelWindowReference) { return JSON.stringify([reference.conversationId, reference.providerResourceIdentityId]); }
}
